about: Settings for .github/workflows/issue-bot.yml. allow: GitHub names whose issues are taken without the auto label. since: issues opened before this date (YYYY-MM-DD) are taken only with the auto label. max_open_prs: no new issue is started while this many of the bot's pull requests wait. max_asks: questions asked on one issue before it goes to needs-simon. skip_labels: issues with any of these are left alone.
